context_build.market_assumption_disagreed_with: The priced assumption that is wrong is that 99th-percentile US yields plus a delivered, pre-telegraphed 25bp hike mark the local peak for 2027H1 implied SOFR. Housing-pain headlines in Australia and a 99th-percentile screen are not a US reversal signal.
